scope: all installed Python distributions in isolated project .venv including development/audit/bootstrap tools; excludes pretrained weights, OS/native libraries and browser tooling

components.name: streamlit
requires_dist: uvloop>=0.15.2; (sys_platform != "win32" and sys_platform != "cygwin" and platform_python_implementation != "PyPy") and extra == "performance"

components.name: uvicorn
requires_dist: uvloop>=0.15.1; (sys_platform != 'win32' and (sys_platform != 'cygwin' and platform_python_implementation != 'PyPy')) and extra == 'standard'
